official.english_requirement: Most Master's degree programmes at ETH Zurich are taught in English; some require both English and German, and some are taught in German. A language certificate recognised by ETH Zurich must be submitted by the application deadline at the latest - applications with an invalid, insufficient or missing certificate are not evaluated and are rejected on formal grounds. Applicants who completed a Bachelor's degree programme completely taught in English are exempt, if the language of instruction is officially confirmed by the university (no confirmation required for Bachelor's degrees from Australia, Ireland, New Zealand, the United Kingdom and the United States). TOEFL, IELTS and C1 Advanced certificates must be no more than two years old.

applicant_utility.summary: ESOP is ETH Zurich's flagship Master scholarship for newcomers: roughly 60 awards per intake combining CHF 13,500 per semester with a tuition waiver, so a three-semester Master is funded at about CHF 40,500 plus tuition on top. The application is not separate - you select ESOP inside the eApply Master application during the single November window and must also upload a thesis pre-proposal, a step many applicants discover too late. Realistically only applicants who can document top-10% standing in their Bachelor's cohort should apply, and the process can include a February phone or video interview.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Top-10% Bachelor graduates entering an ETH Zurich Master's programme for the first time who need full study and living-cost funding.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm you can document top-10% standing in your Bachelor's programme before the window opens on 1 November
Draft the Master thesis pre-proposal early, following ETH's published guidelines, with correct scientific citations
Secure two professor referees willing to upload letters via the system if your programme requires no references
Check your target programme's required language certificate and its validity window before applying
Keep the phone number on your CV reachable in February, or notify the study programme coordinator in advance
common_rejection_risks: Applying in a later Master application window - ESOP requires the first window, 1-30 November
Missing, invalid or insufficient language certificate: the file is rejected on formal grounds without departmental evaluation
A pre-proposal that is plagiarized, ghost-written or improperly cited
Referees never uploading letters because they were not named in the system in time
Already being enrolled in a Master's at ETH or holding a Master's degree, which disqualifies outright
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Tuition and CHF 13,500 per semester are covered, but ETH publishes no travel, installation or insurance allowance, so flights, visa fees, health insurance surpluses and any costs beyond the stipend remain self-funded.
document_audit: The thesis pre-proposal is an extra document on top of the standard Master admission dossier - build time for it
Reference letters arrive only via a system email to named professors; forgetting to name them silently weakens the file
ETH's recognised-certificate lists are conclusive - an English test accepted elsewhere may still be refused
alerts: One-shot window: 1-30 November 2026 only; a Master application filed later forfeits ESOP eligibility entirely
Two closing times appear on the page (11.59h and 12.59 MEZ) - submit well before midday on 30 November
Only ETH Bachelor students may begin the ESOP with a leave of absence
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Submit the eApply Master application inside the November window with ESOP selected and the pre-proposal uploaded, then await the end-of-March decision, with a possible February interview in between.

official.deadline_note: For the 2027 fellowship, applications must be submitted within the first Master's application window: 15 December for applications submitted via IS-Academia (external candidates, and EPFL students changing field), and 31 January 2027 for EPFL students applying for a consecutive Master's degree in the same field (application and recommendation letters). Only applications paid for and validated by 15 December are eligible; reference letters are due one week after the application deadline, with the exact date given in the confirmation email.

The fellowships are part of the 'Attract Talent' pillar of EPFL's philanthropic Student Support Program.

applicant_utility.summary: EPFL's Master Excellence Fellowship pays CHF 10,000 per semester for up to four semesters plus a reserved student room, but it is a stipend rather than full funding - EPFL states students manage all living expenses including tuition fees and rent, so you must independently cover roughly CHF 20,000 or more per semester of other costs. Applying costs nothing extra: you check the fellowship box in the Master application, but only applications paid for and validated inside the first window (15 December for IS-Academia applicants) can be considered. Second-year renewal is mechanical - keep a 5.0/6 weighted average over at least 50 ECTS - and combining the award with another substantial scholarship requires declaring it first.
applicant_utility.best_fit: High-achieving students starting an EPFL Master's - especially external candidates who value guaranteed campus housing and a stipend layered on top of their own funding.
application_readiness_checklist: Submit and pay the Master application early enough to be validated by 15 December, not merely started
Track the confirmation email for the reference-letter upload deadline, one week after the application deadline
Ask referees early: letters must come directly from professors, never routed through the applicant
Declare all scholarships already received or expected during the Master's to avoid a later conflict
Internal same-field candidates: send CV, motivation letter, transcript and two letters to the section by 31 January
common_rejection_risks: Application paid or validated after 15 December - it is reviewed for admission but becomes ineligible for the fellowship
Referees missing the one-week letter upload window after the deadline
Second-year renewal falling below a 5.0/6 average or 50 ECTS - EPFL grants no exceptions
Deferring or postponing admission, which forfeits the fellowship entirely
An undeclared combination with another substantial scholarship
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Tuition fees, rent, insurance, travel and daily living costs: EPFL states fellows are responsible for all living expenses including tuition and rent; only the CHF 10,000 per semester stipend and a reserved student room are provided.
document_audit: External candidates need no extra documents - the real trap is forgetting the fellowship checkbox in the application form
Internal candidates must have professors send letters directly to the section/fellowship mailbox; applicant-routed letters are not the published route
Only paid and validated applications qualify - a pending unpaid file on 15 December does not count as a fellowship application
alerts: You may apply for only one Master's programme per year, and the fellowship must be requested with that same first application
Deferring admission loses the scholarship; you must reapply through the standard process the following year
Switching study programme after the award does not guarantee the scholarship continues
Recipients must open their own Swiss bank or postal account on arrival, and should bring funds for the first month since payment processing takes time
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Check the fellowship box in the IS-Academia Master application, pay and validate before 15 December, referees upload within a week; the sections preselect and the Excellence Fellowships Committee decides, with notifications from late March.
